SELECT
  toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfSecond(timestamp)) AS s,
  countIf(event_message LIKE '%canceling statement due to statement timeout%') AS n_timeout,
  countIf(log_attributes['parsed.sql_state_code'] = '57014') AS n_57014,
  countIf(event_message LIKE '%canceling statement due to user request%') AS n_user,
  groupArray(extract(log_attributes['parsed.query'], '"public"[.]"([a-z0-9_]+)"')) AS rels,
  groupArray(toString(timestamp)) AS ts,
  groupArray(log_attributes['parsed.session_id']) AS sessions
FROM logs
WHERE source = 'postgres_logs'
  AND (event_message LIKE '%canceling statement due to%' OR log_attributes['parsed.sql_state_code'] = '57014')
  AND {{time_filter}}
GROUP BY s
ORDER BY s
